text:
alex: Hey team — Alex here, starting this week. Quick question about privacy/processor access: I'm going to run an internal research task that needs customer logs. Do I need a DPIA or any special signoff? Also saw a phish-sim notice in my inbox — are contractors included by default?
people-ops: Welcome Alex! For production log access you need a manager approval + security signoff. Please submit the access request form: https://redwood.example.com/access-request. DPIA is only required if you're moving PII outside our systems or doing a new processing purpose. Contractors are usually included in phish sims unless explicitly exempted — we can check.
sam: @alex also note: do NOT use personal laptops to access logs. Use your company Mac or the secure jumpbox. FileVault must be on and EDR enabled.
jordan: Enrollment steps: open Company Portal -> Devices -> Enroll. Or run the quick command we give new hires: `curl -sS https://redwood.example.com/onboard | bash` (just kidding — follow the portal UI :grimacing:). If you need a loaner, @people-ops can arrange.
security-bot: PhishSim bot: scheduled test on 2026-04-01 09:00 UTC. Targets: all staff + contractors with @redwood.ai email. Exemptions must be requested by people-ops at least 72h ahead. More: https://redwood.example.com/phishsim
alex: Thanks — who specifically approves the access request? My manager is Mia.
mia: @alex yes I'll approve the access request once you paste the ticket number here. Security does the final signoff for production-level pulls.
sam: And quick reminder: if you plan to copy any customer data for the eval, you need to complete the privacy removal checklist and get data-privacy approval.
alex: Filing the access request now, will drop the ticket number in a bit (ETA ~30m).
people-ops: Noted. When you file, mark your employment type (full-time vs contractor). Contractors need explicit exemption flags for phishsim opt-out. We'll follow up.
alex: I'm full-time — thanks! :tada:
security: FYI @alex I've pasted a short onboarding checklist for devs handling logs: 1) access request ticket 2) signed data-handling acknowledgement 3) MDM enrolled + FileVault on 4) no access from personal devices 5) minimal retention policy documented. Ping us if the research requires PII or cross-border transfers.
alex: Great — appreciate the clear checklist, thanks everyone!
